signatureFeatures: stocky, rounded adult raccoon on short legs, back carried level (not hunched)
grey-brown coat with a darker, streaked back and a warm tan underside
dark brown-black eye mask with cream brows and a cream muzzle
full tail with five dark rings on tan, dark tip
dark brown lower legs and hand-like paws
stevie.proportions: compact, rounded body on short legs, head held level; stocky rather than lean; sleeker and less hunched than Jimothy

signatureFeatures: very fluffy coat with a warm brown cast
big fluffy tail with broad dark and tan bands
dark eye mask, cream brows and muzzle, bright round eyes
jimothy.proportions: short spine, round chubby body carried low, short legs, big tail
